$comment: P2P collateralised lending on Liquid, wire-compatible with the simplicity-lending reference implementation (github BlockstreamResearch/simplicity-lending, `smplx-sdk` covenants). This 'v2' manifest reproduces that protocol's exact on-chain transaction layout so offers created with tx-manifest-wallet are discoverable and settleable by simplicity-lending's own CLI / indexer / web app, and vice-versa. Key differences from the standalone 'lending' example: (1) the principal payout AND the borrower NFT both go to the borrower's plain wallet address (an explicit v0 P2WPKH), committed into the covenant as sha256(scriptPubKey) — there is no p2pk covenant and no separate claim step; (2) the borrower NFT is held in the borrower's wallet during the active loan and spent with an ordinary signature on repayment; (3) NFT ordering is first-params, second-params, borrower, lender; (4) the creation OP_RETURN carries borrower_pubkey || principal_asset_id (64 bytes, internal asset order) for indexer discovery; (5) a single amounts_decimals drives the bit-packed parameter NFTs, matching the reference wallet.

pre_lock.$comment: Collateral held in the PreLockCovenant while the borrower's offer is open. PATH::LEFT (create_lending_path) lets a lender activate the loan; PATH::RIGHT (cancel_pre_lock_path) lets the borrower cancel with a Schnorr signature, burning all Utility NFTs. Address is byte-identical to simplicity-lending's pre_lock covenant for the same parameters.

lending_collateral.$comment: Collateral locked in the active LendingCovenant. Released via repayment (borrower returns principal+interest, reclaims collateral) or liquidation (lender claims collateral after LOAN_EXPIRATION_TIME).

prelock_script_auth.$comment: ScriptAuth covenant wrapping the Utility NFTs during the offer phase. Verifies co-spending with the pre_lock UTXO (input 0).

lending_script_auth.$comment: ScriptAuth covenant wrapping the two Parameter NFTs during the active loan phase. Verifies co-spending with the lending_collateral UTXO (input 0). Unlike the standalone example, the Borrower NFT is NOT wrapped here — it lives in the borrower's wallet.

lender_principal_vault.$comment: AssetAuth covenant holding the principal+interest payment from the borrower. The lender withdraws by co-spending and burning the Lender NFT.

Prepare.$comment: Utility method to split a wallet UTXO into 4 L-BTC UTXOs for the four issuances in IssueUtilityNFTs.

inputs.$comment: Wallet UTXO to split into 4 for IssueUtilityNFTs

PrepareLender.$comment: Utility: ensure the lender wallet has a PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT-sat UTXO of PRINCIPAL_ASSET_ID ready for SetupLending. Accepts any UTXO of that asset and splits off the exact amount needed.

inputs.$comment: Any wallet UTXO holding PRINCIPAL_ASSET_ID (at least PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT sat).

outputs.$comment: Exact PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT sat ready for SetupLending principal_in.

lending_contract.$comment: P2P collateralised lending contract, wire-compatible with simplicity-lending. One instance per loan offer. Created by IssueUtilityNFTs; advanced through LockCollateral, SetupLending, RepayLoan / LiquidateAfterExpiry, and ClaimPrincipalWithInterest.

IssueUtilityNFTs.$comment: Borrower issues four Liquid NFTs (First/Second Parameters NFTs, Borrower NFT, Lender NFT — in that output order). Computes all covenant hashes and the borrower payout commitment, then writes the instance file.

borrower_pub_key.ui_help: Borrower's BIP340 Schnorr public key. Used for offer cancellation authorization and stored in the discovery OP_RETURN.

borrower_output_script_hash.ui_help: SHA-256 of the borrower's explicit (unblinded) index-0 P2WPKH scriptPubKey. Committed into the covenant as both PRINCIPAL_OUTPUT_SCRIPT_HASH and BORROWER_NFT_OUTPUT_SCRIPT_HASH — this is exactly what simplicity-lending bakes via hash_script(signer.get_address().script_pubkey()).

borrower_address.ui_help: The borrower's explicit (unblinded) index-0 address string. The principal and Borrower NFT are paid here on activation; its scriptPubKey hashes to BORROWER_OUTPUT_SCRIPT_HASH. Fund collateral from this same address so a third-party lender can reconstruct the offer.

amounts_decimals.ui_help: Single decimal mantissa applied to BOTH collateral and principal when bit-packing the Parameter NFTs. The bit-packed amount is `amount / 10^amounts_decimals` and must round-trip exactly, so COLLATERAL_AMOUNT and PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT must each be exact multiples of 10^amounts_decimals, and each `amount / 10^amounts_decimals` must fit in 25 bits (< 33,554,432). Default 0 is lossless for any amount below 33,554,432 (use this unless your amounts are larger). Raise it (e.g. to 1, matching simplicity-lending's demo) only with amounts that are exact multiples of 10^amounts_decimals — a non-divisible amount is silently truncated in the NFT, which makes the offer both unindexable and unspendable.

collateral_asset_id.ui_help: Liquid asset ID of the collateral (e.g., L-BTC).

collateral_amount.ui_help: Exact collateral amount in asset base units (multiple of 10^amounts_decimals).

principal_asset_id.ui_help: Liquid asset ID of the loan currency (e.g., a test USDT).

principal_amount.ui_help: Exact principal amount requested, in asset base units (multiple of 10^amounts_decimals).

principal_interest_rate.ui_help: Interest rate in basis points (10,000 = 100%). Max 65,535 basis points.

loan_expiration_time.ui_help: Block height at or after which the lender may liquidate (CLTV). Max 2^27-1.

set.instance.second_parameters_encoded: params.collateral_amount / pow(10, amounts_decimals) + params.principal_amount / pow(10, amounts_decimals) * 33554432

inputs.$comment: Wallet UTXO holding at least COLLATERAL_AMOUNT of the collateral asset. Consumed to mint a dedicated, exact-amount collateral UTXO at borrower_address (see collateral_at_borrower output) so LockCollateral can spend it from the committed address. Declared first so it claims a large-enough UTXO before the 1-sat issuance inputs.
Wallet UTXO whose outpoint determines FIRST_PARAMETERS_NFT_ASSET_ID (issued at output 0).
Wallet UTXO whose outpoint determines SECOND_PARAMETERS_NFT_ASSET_ID (issued at output 1).
Wallet UTXO whose outpoint determines BORROWER_NFT_ASSET_ID (issued at output 2).
Wallet UTXO whose outpoint determines LENDER_NFT_ASSET_ID (issued at output 3).

outputs.$comment: First Parameter NFT carrying bit-packed loan terms in the amount field (output 0).
Second Parameter NFT carrying bit-packed base amounts in the amount field (output 1).
Borrower auth NFT (output 2). Amount=1.
Lender auth NFT (output 3). Amount=1.

Dedicated collateral UTXO of exactly COLLATERAL_AMOUNT at the borrower's committed address (explicit). LockCollateral spends this (pinned via from_address), guaranteeing its input 0 is funded from the address whose hash the covenant commits to — which is what makes the offer indexable.
Collateral-asset change back to borrower (surplus over COLLATERAL_AMOUNT).
L-BTC change back to borrower.

LockCollateral.$comment: Borrower locks collateral and the four Utility NFTs into their covenant addresses, creating the open offer on-chain. Output order — pre_lock collateral (0), first-params (1), second-params (2), borrower (3), lender (4), discovery OP_RETURN (5) — matches simplicity-lending's create_pre_lock so a third-party lender can activate it. Fund collateral from BORROWER_ADDRESS.

inputs.$comment: Borrower's collateral UTXO — pinned to borrower_address so it is spent from the exact address whose hash the covenant commits to. This is the UTXO staged by IssueUtilityNFTs, and it is what the indexer reconstructs borrower_output_script_hash from (input 0's prevout).
First Parameter NFT from wallet.
Second Parameter NFT from wallet.
Borrower NFT from wallet.
Lender NFT from wallet.
Wallet L-BTC UTXO covering the transaction fee.

outputs.$comment: Collateral locked in the PreLockCovenant (output 0).
First Parameter NFT locked in prelock ScriptAuth (output 1).
Second Parameter NFT locked in prelock ScriptAuth (output 2).
Borrower NFT locked in prelock ScriptAuth (output 3).
Lender NFT locked in prelock ScriptAuth (output 4).
Discovery OP_RETURN (output 5): borrower_pubkey (32) || principal_asset_id (32, internal order) = 64 bytes, exactly simplicity-lending's encode_creation_op_return_data.
Collateral change back to borrower.
L-BTC change back to borrower.

CancelOffer.$comment: Borrower cancels the open offer. Requires a BORROWER_PUB_KEY signature. Collateral returned; all Utility NFTs burned. Spends pre_lock via PATH::RIGHT.

inputs.$comment: Pre-lock collateral UTXO (index 0).
First Parameter NFT in prelock ScriptAuth (index 1).
Second Parameter NFT in prelock ScriptAuth (index 2).
Borrower NFT in prelock ScriptAuth (index 3).
Lender NFT in prelock ScriptAuth (index 4).
Wallet L-BTC for fees.

outputs.$comment: Collateral returned to borrower (output 0).

SetupLending.$comment: Lender activates the loan by spending the pre_lock covenant (PATH::LEFT). Collateral moves to LendingCovenant; principal is delivered to the borrower's wallet; the Borrower NFT is returned to the borrower's wallet; the Lender NFT goes to the lender. Layout matches simplicity-lending's create_lending_from_pre_lock.

inputs.$comment: Pre-lock collateral UTXO (index 0).
First Parameter NFT in prelock ScriptAuth (index 1).
Second Parameter NFT in prelock ScriptAuth (index 2).
Borrower NFT in prelock ScriptAuth (index 3).
Lender NFT in prelock ScriptAuth (index 4).
Lender's wallet UTXO providing the principal (index 5).
Wallet L-BTC for fees (index 6).

outputs.$comment: Collateral at LendingCovenant (output 0).
Principal delivered to the borrower's explicit wallet address (output 1). scriptPubKey hashes to PRINCIPAL_OUTPUT_SCRIPT_HASH.
First Parameter NFT under lending ScriptAuth (output 2).
Second Parameter NFT under lending ScriptAuth (output 3).
Borrower NFT returned to the borrower's explicit wallet address (output 4). scriptPubKey hashes to BORROWER_NFT_OUTPUT_SCRIPT_HASH.
Lender NFT to the lender's wallet (output 5).

RepayLoan.$comment: Borrower repays principal+interest and reclaims collateral. Spends lending_collateral via PATH::LEFT. The Borrower NFT is spent from the borrower's wallet with an ordinary signature (index 3). Layout matches simplicity-lending's repay_loan.

inputs.$comment: Active lending collateral UTXO (index 0).
First Parameter NFT in lending ScriptAuth (index 1).
Second Parameter NFT in lending ScriptAuth (index 2).
Borrower NFT held in the borrower's wallet (index 3). Spent with an ordinary wallet signature.
Borrower's wallet UTXO providing principal+interest (index 4).
Wallet L-BTC for fees (optional if principal is L-BTC).

outputs.$comment: Collateral returned to borrower (output 0).
Principal+interest to the lender's AssetAuth vault (output 1). scriptPubKey hashes to LENDER_PRINCIPAL_COV_HASH.

LiquidateAfterExpiry.$comment: Lender claims collateral after loan expiry. Spends lending_collateral via PATH::RIGHT; the covenant enforces nLockTime >= LOAN_EXPIRATION_TIME (check_lock_height). Layout matches simplicity-lending's liquidate_loan.

inputs.$comment: Active lending collateral UTXO (index 0). nSequence enables absolute locktime.
First Parameter NFT in lending ScriptAuth (index 1).
Second Parameter NFT in lending ScriptAuth (index 2).
Lender NFT from wallet (index 3).
Wallet L-BTC for fees.

outputs.$comment: Collateral sent to lender (output 0).

ClaimPrincipalWithInterest.$comment: Lender withdraws principal+interest from the lender_principal_vault by co-spending and burning the Lender NFT.

inputs.$comment: The lender_principal_vault UTXO (index 0).
Lender NFT (amount=1), index 1.
Wallet L-BTC for fees.

outputs.$comment: Principal+interest delivered to lender (output 0).
Lender NFT burned (required by WITH_ASSET_BURN=true), output 1.
